verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a GPU cloud platform, since cloud consoles can ship one, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows Lambda offering an in-product assistant you can delegate tasks to. The only agent-related item is an unofficial, third-party CLI/MCP server built by a community developer. That is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
